verified_chain.qualification: Image metadata describes PNG encoding; does not determine model output encoding

verified_chain.observation: channel means0.485/0.456/0.406 and std0.229/0.224/0.225 normalization; no gamma operation
features passed through sigmoid, range0..1; field queries at mesh vertices; no separately estimated albedo/roughness/light decomposition in inspected export path
verified_chain.qualification: float dtype/range/sigmoid do not prove linear or sRGB; model training targets unverified

verified_chain.observation: float CPU numpy passed to vertex_colors; Trimesh4.0.5 to_rgba multiplies255, rounds to uint8, adds opaque alpha; numeric[.1,.5,.9] -> [26,128,230,255]
verified_chain.qualification: no transfer function at this boundary

verified_chain.observation: normalized UNSIGNED_BYTE VEC4 COLOR_0 written directly; raw originals contain no materials entry or primitive material reference
verified_chain.qualification: glTF specification says COLOR_0 linear used as-is; texture sRGB rules do not apply to these no-texture outputs
